facts.text: Ohio residents who qualify for a Pell Grant and show significant need get aid covering full tuition and mandatory fees, on any Ohio State campus. There's no separate application; eligibility comes from the FAFSA, so file by the priority deadline.
Second-year students can join STEP: a small group that meets weekly with a faculty mentor, plus a fellowship of up to $2,000 for a project of their own.
All unmarried full-time students who are within two years of high school graduation are required to live in on-campus housing.
